item_short_desc: Rothco's Canvas Shoulder Holster is crafted from durable heavyweight canvas, providing a reliable and long-lasting solution for carrying .45 caliber handguns. Featuring an adjustable fit and comfortable shoulder design, this holster is perfect for tactical use, law enforcement, and everyday concealed carry.
